name: Hiddekel
line: Hiddekel is the Bible's old name for the Tigris, a great river named as one of four rivers of Eden and the place where Daniel saw a vision.

moments.title: A river of Eden
moments.text: The Tigris is named as the third river of Eden. It runs along the east side of Assyria.

moments.title: Daniel's vision by the river
moments.text: Daniel is standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris, when he looks up and sees a man dressed in linen. Only Daniel sees the vision, and he is left powerless until a hand touches him.
